params.body:
## What

Frederik (cutover day): "komt de Real Garant calculator er niet door", and the "auto lease" chip on the iframe cards should be capitalised.

**1. Real Garant calculator back on the iframe detail.** Delta's iframe detail showed, for a warranty-eligible vehicle, the warranty banner with `stocklist._tabs.warranty.warranty` (program + period selects, price) and a link to the Real Garant info pdf. The redesign kept only a static sentence. Now the banner loads the calculator again from `real-garant.show?view=website` (the same `_return` partial the stocklist detail uses, so the same RealGarant request `RealGarantWireShapeTest` pins) and drives it in vanilla JS, following the FlexLease block on the same page: the partial's inline `contracts(this)` / `setPrice(this)` are provided by the page without jQuery, and the partial now carries its contracts as `data-contracts` so the period list can be rebuilt. A 204 (not connected/sealed) removes the whole block, like the stocklist detail. Info pdf link below the sentence, NL or FR by `$lang`.

**2. Chip "Auto lease".** `website.auto_lease` in nl ("Auto lease"), fr ("Leasing auto"), en ("Car lease"), de ("Auto-Leasing"); the card chip and the detail lease title use it.

Styling in `public/css/website-detail.css` (the iframe's own stylesheet, refresh.css is not loaded there), same select look as the lease block.

## Rules and tests

- R S2-5.15 (calculator + pdf on the iframe detail), R S2-5.16 (chips), finding `2026-09-15-iframe-real-garant-calculator-weg.md` (opgelost, beslist Frederik).
- `WebsiteWarrantyCalculatorTest`: eligible vehicle carries `#real-garant`, the `real-garant.show?view=website` url and the NL pdf; fr page links the FR pdf; ineligible vehicle (mileage 0) has neither; chip label capitalised in every language.
- Filter `Website|Warranty|RealGarant|WireShape|Flexlease|FlexLease|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|StylesheetSyntax`: OK (124 tests, 1228 assertions).

## Screenshots (1440)

Before: `.playwright-mcp/iframe-warranty/before-1440-warranty-block.png` (static banner). After: `.playwright-mcp/iframe-warranty/after-1440-warranty-block.png` (banner + intro + pdf link + program/period selects + price; switching program Premium→Elite and period to 36 months moved the price 299 → 899 in the browser).

## Open

The two banner sentences ("Uitgebreide waarborg", "Deze wagen komt in aanmerking ...") are hardcoded Dutch as the redesign left them; intro and pdf link follow the language.
params.title: The iframe detail shows the Real Garant calculator again
